title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The Solutions Towards a Better Future programme will work in Centre Department and Port-au-Prince City, Haiti. It aims to contribute to Concern Haiti’s Durable Solutions thematic programme, and the goal of the grant is to increase the socio-economic resilience and self-reliance of the most vulnerable displacement-affected households through improved access to diversified livelihoods and improved social capital. The programme will support over 18,500 people living in Extreme poor households, female headed households, households with disabled members, youth, IDPs. This will be done through improved access to business knowledge and skills, adoption of climate-smart agricultural practices among displaced and host communities, strengthened and more inclusive urban rural trade linkages for increased returns on livelihoods assets and effort and increased programme and community knowledge of root causes of conflict and links to displacement.. RM Mitigation 1: an output from this outcome is using renewable energy for well pumping. RM Adaptation 1: two outputs from outcome 1 are focused on climate adaptation: doption of climate-smart agricultural practices among displaced and host communities and Increased knowledge of community risks and reduced vulnerability to identified risk. DRR 1: One ouput focuses on iIncreased knowledge of community risks and reduced vulnerability to identified risks. Capacity Building 1: This outcome includes capacity assessments throughout the programme cycle to help identify the changing needs for training and support. Gender Equality 1: This outcome includes regular gender and positive masculinity training sessions. Nutrition 1: This outcome includes and output on improved nutrition behaviours i.e. knowledge and practices.
